title: Financial Institutions, Inc. Announces Quarterly Cash Dividend
summary: WARSAW, N.Y., May 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Financial Institutions, Inc. (NASDAQ: FISI) (the “Company”), parent company of Five Star Bank and Courier Capital, LLC, announced that today its Board of Directors approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.32 per outstanding common share. The Company also announced dividends of $0.75 per share on its Series A 3% preferred stock and $2.12 per share on its Series B-1 8.48% preferred stock. All dividends are payable July 2, 2026, to shareholders of record on June 12, 2026. About Financial Institutions, Inc. Financial Institutions, Inc. (NASDAQ: FISI) is a financial holding company with approximately $6.3 billion in assets as of March 31, 2026, offering banking and wealth management products and services.
